Callout.Name: Foot Pursuit Backup
Callout.Message: Officer in a foot pursuit, requesting assistance.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect running, officer behind, no weapon seen.

Script.Line: He went through the gardens and I am not going over that fence on my own.
He is in the back of those houses. I have not lost him.
Two of us and a cordon. That is what this needs.

Lines.Approach: He is on foot with the officer right behind him. Get into the next street.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
